name.zh: 短暂停火，让弹着重新收拢
name.en: Pause fire to tighten the spread

summary.zh: 连射换来更多子弹，也可能让后续射击偏得更远。
summary.en: Sustained fire sends more rounds but may scatter later shots farther.

rules.zh: 连续射击会累积散布或后坐偏移，停火后逐步恢复。玩家观察准星扩张和弹着，决定一直压住扳机，还是分成短点射；远近距离会改变哪种节奏更划算。
rules.en: Repeated firing builds spread or recoil, which recovers after a pause. Read the reticle and impacts to choose continuous fire or short bursts; distance changes which rhythm is useful.

loop.en: Continue firing or release to recover

decisions.zh: 近处大目标可以承受较大散布；远处小目标是否值得少打几发换准度？
decisions.en: A large nearby target tolerates spread; is a small distant target worth firing fewer, tighter shots at?

decisions.zh: 等准星收拢时，敌人是否会先走进掩体？
decisions.en: Will the enemy reach cover while you wait for the reticle to tighten?

effect.zh: 累积快、恢复慢会鼓励短点射；恢复太快会让停火几乎没有代价。
effect.en: Fast build-up and slow recovery favor short bursts; instant recovery makes pauses nearly free.

effect.zh: 让准星大小对应可能落点，玩家才能把偏差归因于规则而非运气。
effect.en: A reticle that reflects possible impacts lets players understand misses instead of attributing them only to luck.

contrast.zh: 深岩银河的例子突出散布累积与恢复；SYNTHETIK 还把移动状态纳入准确度取舍。
contrast.en: The DRG example highlights spread recovery; SYNTHETIK also makes movement state part of the accuracy trade-off.

combination.zh: 组合提案：敌人抬枪前显示短暂射击提示，玩家利用对方准备阶段停火恢复，在敌人开枪前完成一轮精准点射。
combination.en: Design proposal: telegraph an enemy shot, letting players recover accuracy during its preparation and fire a precise burst before it attacks.

setup.zh: 远处有一个小目标，连射三发后准星已变大。
setup.en: A small distant target remains after three shots widen the reticle.

action.zh: 松开扳机半秒，等准星缩小后再射击。
action.en: Release briefly, wait for the reticle to shrink, then fire.

result.zh: 第二轮更集中，但目标也向出口移动了一段。
result.en: The next burst is tighter, but the target has moved closer to the exit.

next.zh: 重新判断是否还来得及等待下一次恢复。
next.en: Decide whether there is time for another recovery pause.

firstStep.zh: 做一个固定靶、可视准星和随射击增加、随时间下降的散布值。
firstStep.en: Build a fixed target, a visible reticle and one spread value that rises with shots and decays over time.

pitfall.zh: 随机散布过强会掩盖玩家输入；先保留明确的近距离命中范围。
pitfall.en: Excessive randomness hides player control; preserve a clearly reliable close range.

test.zh: 把靶子移远后，玩家是否自发缩短连射长度？
test.en: Do players shorten their bursts when the target moves farther away?
